issues: The solution does not delete the temporary backup file after the share sheet closes (including on failure or cancellation). The sharing logic is handled in src/lib/files.ts, but the file does not implement a finally block or cleanup of the temporary file, so requirement (2) is not satisfied.

The backup uses the legacy readAsStringAsync/writeAsStringAsync functions for receipt photos; the code still imports and uses readPhotoBase64/writePhotoBase64 from src/lib/photos.ts which relies on expo-file-system's legacy API (File.readAsStringAsync/writeAsStringAsync). The requirement is to use the new expo-file-system File API (new File(uri).bytes() and File.write). The current implementation still uses the old API and does not update receipt photo references correctly after restore.
feedback: Implement proper temporary backup file cleanup after sharing and replace legacy file APIs with the new File API for reading/writing receipt photos.
